test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In May 2022, RailTel launched PM-WANI based on _____.

options.text: access to its Wi-Fi at 100 railway stations

solution:
The correct answer is __**access to its Wi-Fi at 100 railway stations**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **RailTel, a Mini Ratna PSU, **has launched** Prime Minister Wi-Fi Access Network Interface (PM-WANI) scheme based on access to its Public Wi-Fi services across 100 railway stations across the country.**
 
• This public-friendly service was virtually launched by RailTel chairman and managing director Puneet Chawla.</st
